settings.image_alt: Densely hand-embroidered heritage textile in crimson and gold
settings.name: Heritage
settings.copy: Heirloom textiles made to be collected, preserved and passed on.

settings.image_alt: Craftswomen of Kutch working together on embroidery
settings.name: Avinya
settings.copy: Artisans in teams of two and three, co-creating original work.

settings.name: Gifting & Collaborations
settings.copy: Handcrafted gifts and custom commissions, for organisations and occasions.

settings.image_alt: Model in a dark embroidered kanchli with a black silk drape
settings.name: The Kanchli, reworked
settings.copy: The Kutchi bodice cut for a modern silhouette, the mirror-work kept exactly as it has always been stitched. Sixty hours on the frame before a single seam is closed.

settings.image_alt: Blue and orange bandhani dupatta over an ivory kurta
settings.name: Bandhani, tied by hand
settings.copy: Thousands of points tied one at a time before the cloth ever meets dye. The pattern only reveals itself when the knots come loose — no two lengths finish alike.

settings.image_alt: Model in a green embroidered shirt
settings.name: Suf, counted from the reverse
settings.copy: Suf is worked from the back of the cloth, counted thread by thread, with no pattern ever drawn. The embroiderer holds the whole geometry in her head.
settings.facts:
Counted thread
No pattern drawn
Edition of 12

settings.name: Handloom, woven in Bhujodi
settings.copy: Woven on pit looms a few kilometres from the atelier, in wool and cotton spun for the desert winter. It softens with every wash rather than fading.
settings.facts:
Pit loom
Wool & cotton
Edition of 30
